en.answer:
That effect of <<12149>> is not an effect that destroys the targeted card during effect resolution.

Therefore, the effect of <<7734>> cannot be activated in response.
en.question: If I activate the effect of an <<12149>> on my field that destroys the targeted card during the End Phase of the next turn, can the effect of <<7734>> be activated in response?
